data.long_description:
Provident presents this beautiful one bedroom apartment in Rove Downtown. Discover a vibrant fusion of art and design at Rove Home By IRTH a new project developed by IRTH Development in the heart of Downtown Dubai. This luxury development features fully furnished studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments. With 384 residences, Rove Home By IRTH is poised to redefine urban living with its youthful spirit, exceptional design, and dynamic art installations. 

Rove Home By IRTH Prime Location

Rove Home By IRTH's prime location in Downtown Dubai keeps residents close to the city's most iconic attractions. Living here means you're only minutes away from:

Burj Khalifa
Dubai Fountain
Dubai Mall
Burj Park
Dubai Opera
Souk Al Bahar
Foundry Progressive Art Space
This central location allows you to immerse yourself in the energy and culture of Dubai's bustling metropolis.

Ground Level Amenities

Rove Café
Podcast Studio
Co-working Area
Convenience Store
Soundproof Meeting Pods
Residents' Mailboxes

These amenities are designed to cater to your everyday needs, making life at Rove Home By IRTH convenient and enjoyable.

First-Level Indoor Amenities

Fitness enthusiasts will enjoy the first-floor indoor gymnasium, while the multi-purpose room provides space for a variety of activities. The arcade zone and movie lounge provide an abundance of entertainment options.

First-Level Outdoor Amenities

For those who prefer the outdoors, the first-level outdoor facilities include:

Infinity Pool
Semi-Olympic Lap Pool
Zen Garden
Open-Air Gym
Running Track
Barbecue Area
Basketball Court
Padel Tennis Court
Jacuzzi
Climbing Wall
Outdoor Lounge and Games Area
Delivery Date: Q4-2026

Rove Home By IRTH Development is a lifestyle choice, not just a place to live. With its prime location, luxurious design, and extensive amenities, it provides a one-of-a-kind living experience in the heart of downtown Dubai.
